lines.text: You tap Pay. The connection drops.
Should a retry charge you twice?
A well-designed checkout sends that purchase with one unique key.
If a retry arrives with the same key, the server returns the saved result, instead of charging again.
Keep the same key for retries of one purchase.
A new key means a new request.
One purchase, one key, one receipt.

notes: L2 was "Should retrying charge you twice?"; misaki stressed retrying on the first syllable (ASR heard "retrain"), and with a stress override ASR heard "retry and". Reworded to "Should a retry charge you twice?" (dictionary pronunciation, same meaning, matches L4).
